chinese_reference: 剑术修行第2章：魔法
target: Sword Training 2: Magic
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 마법에는 6가지 계열이 있다. 3원소 마법이라 불리는 화염, 빙한, 전격계열 마법과/n암흑, 신성, 보조 마법이 있다./n3원소 마법은 빙한 > 화염 > 전격 > 빙한의/n상관 관계를 가지며, 암흑과 신성은 상극 관계이다. 보조 마법은 상관 관계가 없다. 속성을 가진 몬스터를 상극 속성으로 공격하면 두 배의 피해를 입힐 수 있지만, 같은 속성으로 공격하면/n오히려 회복해 버린다.
chinese_reference: 魔法共有6个系别。除了称为3元素魔法的火焰、冰寒、雷电系魔法，/n还有暗黑、神圣和辅助魔法。/n3元素魔法的克制关系是冰寒 > 火焰 > 雷电 > 冰寒，/n暗黑与神圣相互克制，辅助魔法则没有属性克制关系。用克制属性攻击带有属性的怪物，可以造成两倍伤害；但若用相同属性攻击，/n反而会为其恢复。
target: There are six schools of magic: fire, ice, and lightning, known as the three elemental schools,/nplus dark, holy, and support magic./nThe elemental strengths run ice > fire > lightning > ice./nDark and holy oppose each other, while support magic has no such relationship. Attacking an elemental monster with the opposing element deals double damage, but attacking with the same element/nheals it instead.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 剑术修行第3章：细剑
target: Sword Training 3: Light Swords
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 세검은 공격력이 강하고 치명타 확률도 높지만, 방어력이 낮아 쉽게 부러져 버린다. 하지만 가격에 비해 공격력이 뛰어나므로 넉넉히 가지고 다니면서 소모품처럼 사용하는 전법도 가능하다.
chinese_reference: 细剑攻击力强，暴击率也高，但防御力低，容易折断。不过，相较于价格，它的攻击力十分出色。因此，也可以多带几把，将其当作消耗品来使用。
target: Light swords have high attack power and critical-hit rates, but low defense, so they break easily. Their attack power is excellent for the price, though. Carrying several and treating them as expendable weapons is a viable tactic.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 剑术修行第4章：防御入门
target: Sword Training 4: Basic Defense
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 적에게 공격을 받을 때 방어에 성공하면, 무기가 일차적으로 공격을 막는 방어벽 역할을 한다. 무기가 견딜 수 있는 적의 최대 공격력을 한계력이라고 하는데, 그 이상의 공격을 받게 되면 무기가 손상을 입고 내구도가 감소한다. 이것을 "돌파"라고 한다.
chinese_reference: 受到敌人攻击时，若成功防御，武器便会充当第一道屏障，挡住攻击。武器所能承受的敌方最高攻击力称为极限值。受到超过这一数值的攻击时，武器就会受损，耐久度也会下降。这种情况称为“突破”。
target: When you successfully block an enemy attack, your weapon acts as the first line of defense. The greatest attack power it can withstand is its Power Limit. Attacks exceeding that limit damage the weapon and reduce its durability. This is called a "breakthrough."
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 剑术修行第5章：防御进阶
target: Sword Training 5: Intermediate Defense
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 방어에는 무기의 종류와 민첩성이 중요하다. 중검은 적의 공격을 막을 확률을 높여주며, 방어력이 높기 때문에 같은 공격을 받아도 세검보다 피해를 덜 입게 된다. 방어 자세를 취하면 공격을 막을 확률이 두 배가 되므로, 중검을 가지고 방어 자세를 취하면/n적의 공격이 집중된 상황에서 도움이 된다.
chinese_reference: 防御时，武器种类和敏捷十分重要。重剑能提高挡下敌人攻击的概率，而且防御力较高，受到同样的攻击时，伤害比使用细剑时更小。采取防御姿态后，挡下攻击的概率会翻倍。因此，手持重剑采取防御姿态，/n在遭到敌人集中攻击时很有帮助。
target: Weapon type and Agility are important for defense. Heavy swords improve the chance of blocking, and their high defense means you take less damage from the same attack than with a light sword. Taking a defensive stance doubles the chance of blocking. Using a heavy sword in a defensive stance/nis useful when enemies concentrate their attacks on you.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

target: Gain combat experience in the cave.

target: Training 6: Tactics & Gear
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.
Shortened after 2026-09-22 gameplay screenshots showed fixed-width UI clipping.

original: 동료와 함께 싸울 때는 역할 분담이 중요하다. 중검을 든 동료가 적진에 돌격한 사이 세검과 같이 공격력이 강한 검이나, 마법이나 총기를 사용하는 동료가 후방에서 적을 공격하는 전법이 유용하다./n또, 전투 중에도 손에 든 무기와 보조 장비의/n교환이 가능하므로 특성이 다른 무기를 동시에 사용하면 혼자서도 여럿이 같이 싸우는 효과를 낼 수도 있다.
chinese_reference: 与同伴并肩作战时，分工十分重要。让持重剑的同伴冲入敌阵，再由使用细剑等高攻击力武器、魔法或枪械的同伴从后方攻击，是有效的战术。/n此外，战斗中也能将手中的武器与备用装备/n互换。搭配使用不同特性的武器，即使独自一人，也可能发挥出多人协同作战的效果。
target: When fighting alongside companions, assigning roles is important. A useful tactic is to have someone with a heavy sword charge the enemy while companions with powerful weapons such as light swords, magic, or firearms attack from behind./nYou can also swap your equipped weapon/nwith your secondary equipment during combat. Using weapons with different properties lets even a lone fighter achieve the effect of several working together.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

target: Gain combat experience in the cave
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

target: Gain combat experience in the cave.

chinese_reference: 剑术修行第7章：必杀技
target: Sword Training 7: Special Attacks
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 필살기를 사용하려면 기력(XP)이 필요하다. 기력은 적을 공격하면서 조금씩 오르고, 기력이 오름에 따라 공격력과 방어력도 상승한다. 필살기를 사용해도 기력은 줄어들지 않지만, 기력이 가득 찬 상태에서는 시간이 지나면서 소멸하게 된다.
chinese_reference: 使用必杀技需要气力（XP）。攻击敌人时，气力会逐渐增加，攻击力和防御力也会随之提升。使用必杀技不会减少气力，但气力蓄满后，会随着时间流逝而消散。
target: Special attacks require Vigor (XP). Vigor builds gradually as you attack enemies, increasing attack and defense along with it. Using special attacks does not consume Vigor, but once the gauge is full, it dissipates over time.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 이올린에게 왕국 검법을 사사받았다./n이제 남은 건 아수라에 도전하는 것뿐.
chinese_reference: 我已从伊奥琳那里学会了王国剑法。/n接下来，只剩挑战阿修罗了。
target: I have learned the kingdom's swordsmanship from Iyoline./nAll that remains is to challenge Asura.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 이올린의 검술 수련을 마치고,/n아수라에 도전해 아수라의 주인이 되었다./n이올린은 떠나는 나에게 소중히 간직해 달라며 흑태자가 사용하던 회색 망토를 주었고, 복수라는 굴레에서 벗어나라며 충고를 해 주었다./n하지만 나는 결코 그들을 용서할 수 없다.
chinese_reference: 结束伊奥琳的剑术修行后，/n我挑战了阿修罗，成为它的主人。/n临别时，伊奥琳将黑太子用过的灰色披风交给我，嘱咐我好好珍惜，也劝我摆脱复仇的枷锁。/n但我绝不可能原谅那些人。
target: After completing Iyoline's sword training,/nI challenged Asura and became its master./nAs I left, Iyoline gave me the Black Prince's gray cloak and asked me to treasure it. She also urged me to free myself from the shackles of revenge./nBut I can never forgive them.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

target: Challenge Asura

target: I challenged and defeated Asura, and it accepted me as its master.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

target: Defeating the Pirates
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 폭풍도에서 사이럽스로 돌아가는/n연락선에 올랐다. 그런데 갑자기 해적의 습격을 받았다. 폭풍도로 갈 때는 폭풍, 돌아올 때는 해적이라니.
chinese_reference: 我登上了从风暴岛返回赛勒普斯的/n渡船，却突然遭到海盗袭击。去时遇上暴风，回来又碰上海盗。
target: I boarded a ferry/nfrom Storm Island back to Cyrups. Suddenly, pirates attacked. A storm on the way there, and pirates on the way back.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 虽嫌麻烦，还是收拾海盗吧
target: Deal with the pirates
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 虽嫌麻烦，还是收拾海盗吧。
target: A nuisance, but I should deal with the pirates.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 갑판 위에 오르자, 실버라는 해적 두목이 도전해왔다. 그냥 사이럽스까지만 태워달라고 했지만, 자신을 이기면 평생 동안 종노릇이라고 해준다기에 상대해 주었다. 실버를 꺾어주었더니, 어떤 일을 하던지 힘이 되어주겠다며 배에서 내려 나를 따르겠다고 하기에 좋을 대로 하라고 했다. 실버를 따르던 해적들도 손을 씻을 모양이군.
chinese_reference: 走上甲板，一个叫希尔弗的海盗头目向我挑战。我只是想让他们送我到赛勒普斯，可他说只要赢了他，就愿意给我当一辈子仆人，我便奉陪了。击败希尔弗后，他说不管我要做什么，他都愿意帮忙，要下船跟随我，我就随他去了。跟着他的海盗们，似乎也打算洗手不干了。
target: When I went up on deck, a pirate captain named Silver challenged me. I only asked for passage to Cyrups, but he offered to serve me for life if I defeated him, so I obliged. After I beat him, Silver said he would help me in whatever I did and leave his ship to follow me. I told him to do as he pleased. It seems his pirates intend to give up their old trade too.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 西风之隼……？
target: Zephyr Falcon...?
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 사이럽스를 떠나/n제국령 카라카스 지방에 도착했다./n난데없이 숲에서 어떤 아가씨가 나타나/n제국 병사들과의 싸움에 휘말리게 하고는/n급히 가버렸다. 제피르 팰컨이라고 했던가?/n…오랜만에 듣는 이름이군.
chinese_reference: 离开赛勒普斯后，/n我来到了帝国领内的加拉加斯地区。/n林中突然冒出一个姑娘，/n把我卷入与帝国士兵的战斗，/n转眼又匆匆离开了。她说是西风之隼？/n……真是个久违的名字。
target: I left Cyrups/nand reached the imperial territory of Caracas./nA young woman suddenly appeared in the forest/nand dragged me into a fight with imperial soldiers/nbefore hurrying away. Did she say Zephyr Falcon?/n...A name I haven't heard in a long time.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 到加拉加斯村了。/n找个今晚落脚的地方吧。
target: I've arrived in Caracas Village./nI should find somewhere to stay tonight.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 潜入鲁本宅邸
target: Infiltrating Ruben's Mansion
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 카라카스 영주의 행차를 마주쳤다. 잔혹하기로 유명하다는 영주가, 죽어서도 잊지 못할 루벤이라니. 화형식에서 놈을 치려고 했지만 갑자기 반란군 제피르 팰컨이 난입해, 놈은 도망가버렸다. 루벤을 쫒아 저택으로 향하려는데 어제 마주친 카나라는 아가씨가 저택으로 통하는 비밀 통로를 알고있다며 동행을 요구했다. 뭐, 어려울 건 없지.
chinese_reference: 我遇上了加拉加斯领主的队伍。那个以残暴闻名的领主，竟然就是我至死也忘不了的鲁本。我本想在火刑仪式上动手，叛军西风之隼却突然闯入，让他逃掉了。正要追去他的宅邸，昨天遇见的姑娘卡娜说，她知道一条通往宅邸的密道，要与我同行。也好，这倒不难。
target: I encountered the Lord of Caracas's procession. The lord infamous for his cruelty turned out to be Ruben, a man I could never forget, even in death. I tried to strike at him during a burning at the stake, but Zephyr Falcon rebels suddenly intervened and he escaped. As I was about to pursue him to his mansion, Kana, the young woman I met yesterday, said she knew a secret passage inside and asked to accompany me. Well, no harm in that.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 잔혹하기로 유명하다는 카라카스 영주가, 죽어서도 잊지 못할 루벤이라니. 화형식에서 놈을 치려고 했지만 갑자기 반란군 제피르 팰컨이 난입해, 놈은 도망가버렸다. 루벤을 쫒아 저택으로 향하려는데 제피르 팰컨의 카나라는 아가씨가 저택으로 통하는 비밀 통로를 알고있다며 동행을 요구했다./n저택에 잠입해 놈을 찾아냈지만, 놈은 이미 허수아비를 세워둔 채 도망친 후였다.
chinese_reference: 那个以残暴闻名的加拉加斯领主，竟然就是我至死也忘不了的鲁本。我本想在火刑仪式上动手，叛军西风之隼却突然闯入，让他逃掉了。正要追去他的宅邸，西风之隼的姑娘卡娜说，她知道一条通往宅邸的密道，要与我同行。/n潜入宅邸后，我找到了他，才发现那只是个替身，本人早已逃走。
target: The Lord of Caracas, infamous for his cruelty, turned out to be Ruben, a man I could never forget, even in death. I tried to strike at him during a burning at the stake, but Zephyr Falcon rebels suddenly intervened and he escaped. As I was about to pursue him to his mansion, Kana of Zephyr Falcon said she knew a secret passage inside and asked to accompany me./nWe infiltrated the mansion and found him, but it was only a dummy. He had already fled.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

target: Pass through the underground waterway
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 穿过地下水道，/n寻找通往宅邸的入口。
target: Pass through the underground waterway/nand find the entrance to the mansion.

chinese_reference: 寻找鲁本
target: Find Ruben

chinese_reference: 潜入宅邸了。/n找找鲁本在哪。
target: I've infiltrated the mansion./nNow to find Ruben.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 普雷托利亚的圣女
target: The Saint of Pretoria
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 루벤의 뒤를 쫓고 있는 도중, 영주군 병사들에게 쫓기는 일가족을 마주쳤다. 반역자라며 아이들까지 총격을 가하다니… 절대 용서할 수 없다. 다행히 아이들은 목숨이 붙어있어, 프리토리아의 성녀라 불린다는 의사 에스메랄다를 찾아가 치료를 부탁하기로 했다.
chinese_reference: 追踪鲁本途中，我遇到了一家遭领主军士兵追赶的人。他们竟以叛徒为名，连孩子都开枪射击……绝不能饶恕。幸好孩子们还有一口气，我决定去找被称为普雷托利亚圣女的医生埃斯梅拉达，请她救治。
target: While pursuing Ruben, I came across a family fleeing the lord's soldiers. Calling them traitors and shooting even the children... I will never forgive that. Fortunately, the children were still alive. I decided to find Esmeralda, the doctor known as the Saint of Pretoria, and ask her to treat them.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 루벤의 뒤를 쫓고 있는 도중, 영주군 병사들에게 쫓기는 일가족을 마주쳤다. 반역자라며 아이들까지 총격을 가하다니… 절대 용서할 수 없다. 다행히 아이들은 목숨이 붙어있어, 프리토리아의 성녀라 불린다는 의사 에스메랄다를 찾아가 치료를 부탁했다. 에스메랄다는 사이럽스에서 나를 만났던 일을 기억하고 있는 듯 하다.
chinese_reference: 追踪鲁本途中，我遇到了一家遭领主军士兵追赶的人。他们竟以叛徒为名，连孩子都开枪射击……绝不能饶恕。幸好孩子们还有一口气，我找到了被称为普雷托利亚圣女的医生埃斯梅拉达，请她救治。埃斯梅拉达似乎还记得在赛勒普斯见过我的事。
target: While pursuing Ruben, I came across a family fleeing the lord's soldiers. Calling them traitors and shooting even the children... I will never forgive that. Fortunately, the children were still alive. I found Esmeralda, the doctor known as the Saint of Pretoria, and asked her to treat them. She seems to remember meeting me in Cyrups.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 前往普雷托利亚村
target: Head to Pretoria Village

original: 프리토리아 마을에 가서 에스메랄다에게 아이들의 치료를 부탁하자.
chinese_reference: 去普雷托利亚村，请埃斯梅拉达救治孩子们。
target: Go to Pretoria Village and ask Esmeralda to treat the children.

chinese_reference: 营救埃斯梅拉达
target: Rescuing Esmeralda
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 아이들의 상태를 살피러 병원으로 향했지만, 간호사로부터 에스메랄다가 프리토리아의 영주 라몬에게 끌려가 버렸다는 이야기를 들었다. 구애에 거절당했다고 앙심을 품고 마녀라는 누명을 씌우다니, 옹졸한 녀석이군. 에스메랄다를 구하러 가자.
chinese_reference: 我去医院探望孩子们，却从护士那里得知，埃斯梅拉达被普雷托利亚领主拉蒙带走了。求爱遭拒，竟怀恨在心，诬陷她是女巫，真是个心胸狭窄的家伙。去救埃斯梅拉达吧。
target: I went to the hospital to check on the children, but a nurse told me Esmeralda had been taken away by Ramon, Lord of Pretoria. He resented her rejection of his advances and accused her of being a witch. What a petty man. I must rescue Esmeralda.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 아이들의 상태를 살피러 병원으로 향했지만, 간호사로부터 에스메랄다가 프리토리아의 영주 라몬에게 끌려가 버렸다는 이야기를 들었다. 구애에 거절당했다고 앙심을 품고 마녀라는 누명을 씌우다니, 옹졸한 녀석이군. 라몬의 저택을 수색하던 중, 악덕 영주만 노린다는 괴도 샤른호스트와 마주쳐 동행하게 되었다. 지하 고문실에 갇혀있던 에스메랄다를 구출하고 나니, 샤른호스트는 어느새 조용히 사라져 버렸다.
chinese_reference: 我去医院探望孩子们，却从护士那里得知，埃斯梅拉达被普雷托利亚领主拉蒙带走了。求爱遭拒，竟怀恨在心，诬陷她是女巫，真是个心胸狭窄的家伙。搜查拉蒙宅邸时，我遇上了据说专挑恶领主下手的怪盗沙恩霍斯特，便与他同行。救出关在地下刑讯室里的埃斯梅拉达后，沙恩霍斯特不知何时已经悄然离去。
target: I went to the hospital to check on the children, but a nurse told me Esmeralda had been taken away by Ramon, Lord of Pretoria. He resented her rejection of his advances and accused her of being a witch. What a petty man. While searching Ramon's mansion, I met Sharn Hoiste, a notorious thief said to target only corrupt lords, and joined forces with him. After we rescued Esmeralda from the underground torture chamber, Sharn Hoiste quietly vanished.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 埃斯梅拉达似乎被关在/n地下刑讯室。去那里吧。
target: Esmeralda seems to be imprisoned/nin the underground torture chamber. I should go there.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 加拉加斯村解放作战
target: Operation to Liberate Caracas Village
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 약속 장소에 같이 가자는 카나를 따라가보니, 제피르 팰컨의 집결지였다. 그들 일에는 관심이 없어 떠나려는데, 메디치라는 부대장이 뒤늦게 나타났다. 로베르토 데 메디치… 제피르 팰컨… 잊고 있었던 이름을 떠올렸다. 합류를 권하는 클라우제비츠의 제안에, 일단은 같이 행동하기로 했다. 영주 저택에 붙잡힌 카나의 부대원들을 구출하자.
chinese_reference: 卡娜邀我一起去约定地点，跟去一看，竟是西风之隼的集结地。我对他们的事毫无兴趣，正要离开，一个叫梅迪西的部队长姗姗来迟。罗伯托·德·梅迪西……西风之隼……我想起了那个被遗忘的名字。克劳塞维茨邀我加入，我便决定暂时与他们一起行动。去救出被关在领主宅邸里的卡娜的部下吧。
target: I followed Kana to an agreed meeting place, which turned out to be Zephyr Falcon's gathering point. I had no interest in their affairs and was about to leave when a commander named Medici arrived late. Roberto de Medici... Zephyr Falcon... I remembered the name I had forgotten. When Clausewitz invited me to join them, I agreed to work with them for now. We must rescue Kana's soldiers from the lord's mansion.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 카나를 따라 간 제피르 팰컨의 집결지에서, 잊고 있었던 메디치의 이름을 떠올렸다. 클라우제비츠의 권유로 일단 제피르 팰컨과 행동을 같이 하기로 했다. 루벤과 결판을 낸 후, 이 일로 교회 세력에 반기를 든 셈이 되었으니 제피르 팰컨에 정식으로 합류하는게 좋지 않겠냐는 제안에, 결국 제피르 팰컨에 합류해 카나의 4부대에서 행동하기로 했다.
chinese_reference: 跟着卡娜来到西风之隼的集结地，我想起了被遗忘的梅迪西之名。应克劳塞维茨之邀，我决定暂时与西风之隼一起行动。与鲁本做了了断后，他们说，既然此事已经使我站到了教会的对立面，不如正式加入西风之隼。我最终答应了，加入卡娜的第4部队行动。
target: At Zephyr Falcon's gathering point, where Kana had brought me, I remembered Medici's forgotten name. At Clausewitz's invitation, I agreed to work with Zephyr Falcon for now. After I settled matters with Ruben, they suggested that since I had now defied the Church, I might as well join Zephyr Falcon officially. In the end, I joined Kana's Fourth Unit.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 通过地下水道潜入宅邸
target: Infiltrate the mansion through the underground waterway
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 비밀 통로는 마을 북쪽에 있었지./n지하수로를 통해 저택에 잠입하자.
chinese_reference: 密道就在村子北边。/n通过地下水道潜入宅邸吧。
target: The secret passage was north of the village./nI should infiltrate the mansion through the underground waterway.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 붙잡힌 포로를 구출하기 위해 영주 저택 지하 수로로 향했는데, 갑자기 불길한 예감이 들어 혼자 메디치에게 갔다. 메디치는 이루스에게 당해 쓰러져 있었다. 그리마로 변한 이루스와 싸움을 앞두고 있는데, 샤른호스트가 난입해 함께 이루스와 상대했다. 샤른호스트… 흑영의 후예라면서 왕국 검법을 사용하는 이유가 뭐지?
chinese_reference: 为了救出俘虏，我前往领主宅邸的地下水道，却突然涌起不祥的预感，便独自去找梅迪西。梅迪西已被伊鲁斯打倒。正要与化作格里玛的伊鲁斯交手，沙恩霍斯特突然闯入，与我并肩迎战。沙恩霍斯特……自称黑影后裔，为什么会使用王国剑法？
target: I headed for the underground waterway beneath the lord's mansion to rescue the prisoners, but a sudden sense of dread made me go alone to find Medici. Irus had struck him down. As I prepared to fight Irus, who had transformed into a Grima, Sharn Hoiste appeared and joined me. Sharn Hoiste... If he is a descendant of the Black Shadow, why does he use the kingdom's swordsmanship?
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 与鲁本做个了断
target: Settle matters with Ruben
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 루벤이 저택에서 나를 기다리고 있을 거다./n루벤과 결판을 내자.
chinese_reference: 鲁本应该正在宅邸里等我。/n去与他做个了断吧。
target: Ruben will be waiting for me in the mansion./nIt's time to settle matters with him.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 형제나 다름없던 루벤이 나를 배신했던 진실… 루벤은 최후의 순간, 나와 이복동생임을 고백했다. 아버지는 나를 구하기 위해 추기경에서 맞서다 프레데릭과의 결투에서 돌아가셨다./n그리고 나를 함정에 빠뜨린 것은/n체사레 추기경이라는 사실도./n체사레… 이 피비린내 나는 악연,/n반드시 내 손으로 거두어 주마.
chinese_reference: 与我情同手足的鲁本，究竟为何背叛我……临终之际，他承认自己是我的同父异母弟弟。父亲为了救我，挺身对抗枢机主教，最终在与弗雷德里克的决斗中丧命。/n而将我推入陷阱的人，/n正是切萨雷枢机主教。/n切萨雷……这段血腥的孽缘，/n我一定亲手了结。
target: The truth behind Ruben's betrayal, when we had been as close as brothers... At the end, he confessed that we were half brothers. Father stood against the cardinal to save me and died in a duel with Frederick./nAnd the one who had me trapped/nwas Cardinal Cesare./nCesare... This bloody bond between us,/nI will sever it with my own hands.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.
Korean establishes paternal half siblings without explicitly establishing relative age; do not import Chinese younger-brother detail.

chinese_reference: 侦察尼科西亚要塞
target: Scouting Nicosia Fortress
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 체사레가 니코시아 지방에 요새를 세우고 무언가를 준비하고 있다는 정보다. 카나와 함께 니코시아에 가서 무슨 일을 벌이는지 조사하는 임무를 맡았다.
chinese_reference: 情报说，切萨雷在尼科西亚地区修建了要塞，正在准备着什么。我接到任务，要与卡娜一起前往尼科西亚，查清他的打算。
target: Intelligence says Cesare has built a fortress in the Nicosia region and is preparing something. Kana and I have been assigned to go there and investigate.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 체사레가 니코시아 지방에 요새를 세우고 일을 꾸미고 있다고 해, 카나와 함께 니코시아 교회 요새를 조사하는 임무를 맡았다. 교회는 비밀리에 마장기를 제조하고 있었다. 요새에서 만나 함께 싸우게 된 크리스라는 소년이 제피르 팰컨에 가입하고 싶다고 부탁해 와, 함께 기지로 돌아가 클라우제비츠와 의논해 보기로 했다.
chinese_reference: 听说切萨雷在尼科西亚地区修建要塞，暗中谋划着什么，我便与卡娜一同前去调查尼科西亚教会要塞。原来，教会正在秘密制造魔装机。在要塞遇见并一同作战的少年克里斯，请求加入西风之隼。我们决定带他回基地，与克劳塞维茨商议。
target: Cesare was said to be plotting something in a new fortress in the Nicosia region, so Kana and I were assigned to investigate Nicosia Church Fortress. The Church was secretly manufacturing magical war machines. A boy named Chris, whom we met and fought alongside there, asked to join Zephyr Falcon. We decided to take him back to base and discuss it with Clausewitz.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 前往尼科西亚村
target: Head to Nicosia Village
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 니코시아 마을로 향하자. 니코시아는 게이시르 시티를 지나 대륙 남단에 있다./n먼 길이 될 것 같다.
chinese_reference: 前往尼科西亚村吧。穿过盖西尔城，尼科西亚就在大陆南端。/n看来要走很长一段路。
target: Head to Nicosia Village. It lies beyond Gaysir City, at the southern end of the continent./nIt will be a long journey.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 前往尼科西亚教会要塞
target: Go to Nicosia Church Fortress

original: 교회 요새는 니코시아 마을 동쪽에 있다는 정보다. 교회 요새로 향하자.
chinese_reference: 情报说，教会要塞位于尼科西亚村东边。去那里吧。
target: The Church fortress is said to be east of Nicosia Village. I should head there.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 搜索教会要塞内部
target: Search inside the Church fortress
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 搜索教会要塞内部吧。
target: Search inside the Church fortress.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 교회 요새 안에서 감금되어 있던 마을 사람들을 구해 보호하고 있던 크리스라는 소년을 만났다. 함께 싸워줄 수 없겠냐고 부탁하기에 걸리적거리지만 말라고 했다. 나이도 어린 것 같은데, 왜 교회 세력에 맞서 싸우려고 하는 걸까.
chinese_reference: 在教会要塞里，我遇到了一个叫克里斯的少年。他救出了被囚禁的村民，正在保护他们。他问能否与我一起战斗，我只说别碍手碍脚就行。看他年纪还小，为什么要与教会势力为敌呢？
target: Inside the Church fortress, I met a boy named Chris who had freed the captive villagers and was protecting them. He asked to fight alongside me. I told him he could, as long as he stayed out of the way. He seems so young. Why does he want to fight the Church?
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 调查教会要塞西侧
target: Investigate the western part of the Church fortress
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 잠겨있던 교회 요새 서쪽을 조사해 보자.
chinese_reference: 去调查教会要塞原本锁着的西侧吧。
target: Investigate the previously locked western part of the Church fortress.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 교회 요새 서쪽을 조사하던 중, 마장기 아수라 Mk.II를 발견했다. 이런 곳에서 비밀리에 마장기를 만들고 있었다니./n다행히 완성되기 전에 파괴할 수 있었다.
chinese_reference: 调查教会要塞西侧时，我发现了魔装机阿修罗Mk.II。没想到，他们竟在这里秘密制造魔装机。/n幸好，在完工前就将它摧毁了。
target: While investigating the western part of the Church fortress, I discovered the magical war machine Asura Mk.II. They were secretly building it here./nFortunately, we destroyed it before it was completed.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

chinese_reference: 利伯维尔领主的请求
target: A Request from the Lord of Libreville
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 리브레빌의 영주로부터 도움을 요청하는 전령이 왔다고 한다. 군비를 늘려오는 있는 비프로스트가 국경 근처의 영주들을 압박하는 모양이지만, 제국의 영주가 제피르 팰컨에게 도움을 요청하다니. 이상하군.
chinese_reference: 听说利伯维尔领主派来传令兵求援。不断扩充军备的比弗罗斯特，似乎正在向边境附近的领主施压。可帝国领主竟然向西风之隼求援，真是奇怪。
target: A messenger has apparently arrived seeking help from the Lord of Libreville. Bifrost's growing military seems to be putting pressure on the border lords. But an imperial lord asking Zephyr Falcon for help? Strange.
notes: Korean quest journal with Chinese supporting context; names/titles not in approved glossary remain provisional.

original: 리브레빌 영주 에스테 도데의 고민은 마을 동쪽 도로로 일을 나가던 리브레빌 사람들이 실종되고 있다는 것이었다. 새로운 영지로 분리되어 들어선 마을인 안타나나리보의 영주는 얼굴을 드러내지 않고 몬스터를 이용하고 있어 곤란하다는 모양이다.
chinese_reference: 利伯维尔领主埃斯特·多德的烦恼，是村民们沿村东道路外出干活，却接连失踪。塔那那利佛是划分为新领地后建立的村落，那里的领主从不露面，还会驱使怪物，似乎让他颇为头疼。
target: Este Daudet, Lord of Libreville, was troubled by the disappearance of residents who took the eastern road out of town to work. Antananarivo was established as a separate new domain, and its lord apparently keeps out of sight and employs monsters, making matters difficult.
